attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[],"voice":1,"clarity":3,"tone":2,"overall":1,"comment":"It copies the briefing's section labels (\"News since your last bulletin:\", \"Already reported:\") into the text, which breaks character and the no-headings rule. It is also only about 70 words, under the 80 to 150 minimum. The voice is flat and generic, the dry Ilse wit is missing, and the date and faction sizes go unused when they could have filled the quiet week."}
